SearchAliases: Yunmen cut off all streams phrase

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Records use this phrase for words or actions that stop proliferating routes of discrimination and response. The image is “cut off all streams,” and Yunmen-house discussions place it among three phrase-functions alongside covering heaven and earth and following wave after wave.
EvidenceBody: Yuanwu Keqin calls it a solitary voicing of the hidden pivot that cuts off all streams without constraint or turning back. In the Blue Cliff Record he explains that an ordinary Yunmen phrase must contain three phrases: one that covers heaven and earth, one that follows the waves, and one that cuts off all streams.

Ruibai Mingxue says that in a single shout the cutting-off phrase sweeps away ordinary and sage and ends conceptual interpretation. Hanyue Fazang describes unconstrained movement as lion-like and stream-cutting, while Feiyin Tongrong pairs the image with a sword across the sky and an iron pillar. Shiyu Mingfang applies it to the power of a fragrant elephant crossing beyond the mind-ocean. Tianyin Yuanxiu nevertheless says that even cutting off all streams remains outside the gate, preventing the phrase from becoming a final attainment-label.

Senses.Note: Seven exact witnesses in seven independent works support the stream-cutting image; it is a phrase-function and evaluative capacity, not a literal hydrological claim or guaranteed final station.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The stream image turns a phrase or action into a cutoff point for proliferating routes, while the three-phrase frame keeps cutoff beside encompassing and adaptive movement.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Tianyin Yuanxiu explicitly says that cutting off all streams still remains outside the gate, so the phrase cannot by itself certify completion or final arrival.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: All deploy or evaluate the same stream-cutting image, including its explicit limit.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Aliases cover the literal image, Yunmen-house classification, and phrase form without replacing the image with a conceptual abstraction.

ModifierControls.Finding: 眾 marks the plurality of streams or currents cut off; the witnesses do not identify literal waterways.

FamilyControls.Finding: Companion Yunmen phrase-function for encompassing heaven and earth, not merged with cutoff.
